assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology enabled a major therapeutic transformation in diabetes and obesity with broad health consequences.
assessment.attribution: The proposed laureates represent core physiological discovery and translational conceptualization; the wider drug-development contribution complicates a three-person allocation.
assessment.maturity: The mechanism and clinical benefits have been reproduced extensively across many therapies and indications.
uncertainties: Credit for therapeutic development is distributed among additional contributors, including Lotte Bjerre Knudsen.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Antisense correction of SMN2 splicing established a precise molecular therapy for a formerly devastating genetic disease.
assessment.attribution: Krainer and Bennett provide a coherent pairing of splicing mechanism and therapeutic antisense development.
assessment.maturity: Clinical efficacy and durable practical impact make the advance mature.
uncertainties: The underlying disease biology and treatment-development pathway involved important additional contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: HPV virus-like-particle vaccines provide highly effective prevention of infection and cancers, a landmark in preventive medicine.
assessment.attribution: Frazer, Schiller, and Lowy capture central work linking papillomavirus biology to practical prophylactic vaccination.
assessment.maturity: Population-level implementation and sustained vaccine effectiveness support exceptional maturity.
uncertainties: The exact division of foundational and enabling contributions within the larger vaccine field remains difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BCR-ABL inhibition converted chronic myeloid leukemia into a model for molecularly targeted cancer therapy.
assessment.attribution: The proposed trio spans drug development, clinical translation, and demonstration of the therapeutic principle.
assessment.maturity: Long-term clinical use and influence on precision oncology establish durability.
uncertainties: Earlier discovery of BCR-ABL biology and contributions by other drug-development teams broaden the credit landscape.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Modern cochlear implants restored useful hearing and speech access for large numbers of people with profound deafness.
assessment.attribution: Clark and Hochmair are central implant pioneers, while Wilson is strongly associated with decisive speech-processing advances.
assessment.maturity: The technology has demonstrated lasting clinical benefit over decades.
uncertainties: Its engineering, surgical, and signal-processing history is collaborative and difficult to reduce to three individuals.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: CFTR modulators created mechanism-based treatment capable of substantially changing the course of cystic fibrosis.
assessment.attribution: Welsh supplied pivotal CFTR functional biology, and Van Goor and Negulescu represent key therapeutic-modulator development.
assessment.maturity: Multiple approved modulators and broad clinical experience demonstrate robust translational maturity.
uncertainties: Credit for discovery, medicinal chemistry, and clinical development is widely shared.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: PCSK9 united human genetics with a powerful cholesterol-lowering therapeutic strategy and cardiovascular benefit.
assessment.attribution: Hobbs and Cohen represent human genetic validation, while Seidah represents central PCSK9 biology.
assessment.maturity: The causal mechanism and therapeutic effect are well established in clinical practice.
uncertainties: Marianne Abifadel and Catherine Boileau also have important claims within the genetic discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Engineered CAR-T cells opened a powerful therapeutic modality capable of inducing durable remissions in selected cancers.
assessment.attribution: The proposed laureates represent foundational clinical, engineering, and adoptive-cell-therapy contributions.
assessment.maturity: Clinical effectiveness is compelling, though applicability, toxicity, and manufacturing constraints remain significant.
uncertainties: The field has many foundational contributors and credit allocation is especially contested.
Durable impact beyond hematologic malignancies remains less established.
